environment.description: Same Actix-web binary deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB with an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL. The WebACL includes the AWS managed rule group AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with CrossSiteScripting_BODY and CrossSiteScripting_QUERYARGUMENTS rules in COUNT mode (not BLOCK). However, a custom WAFv2 rule with priority 0 uses a RegexPatternSet matching common XSS vectors in the request body (pattern: `(?i)(<script|javascript:|on\w+\s*=|<img[^>]+onerror)`) with action BLOCK. Additionally, the ECS task role has an attached IAM permission boundary that restricts `ssm:GetParameter` and `secretsmanager:GetSecretValue` to prevent credential exfiltration from the task. Session HMAC signing keys are sourced from an external Vault agent sidecar that rotates the signing secret every 60 seconds; sessions signed with a previous-generation key are rejected on the next request, meaning any stolen session cookie (e.g., via document.cookie exfiltration in an XSS payload that somehow bypasses the WAF) becomes invalid within at most 60 seconds. The Vault sidecar exposes keys only via a Unix domain socket with peercred verification (UID match).

config.waf_managed_rules: AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet (XSS rules in COUNT mode only)
config.waf_custom_rule: Priority 0, RegexPatternSet BLOCK on body matching XSS vectors
config.vault_sidecar: HashiCorp Vault Agent, HMAC key rotation every 60s
config.unix_socket_peercred: vault agent socket restricted to task UID
